name: Catch me up
author: wizard
description: Say or type "catch me up" (or "signal sweep") and your Wizard gives one catch-up in two steps: a Clear all list of what needs nothing from you (finished chats, background results, FYIs), then what does need you, a few at a time, with its pick. It reads your waiting chats, your apps and the agent inbox since the last catch-up, so one right after says nothing new. Clear archives what you cleared, "not now" is skipped next time, and nothing is sent, archived or paid without your yes. Works with Smart inbox on or off. Read by the Agent Service (wizard-agent-service issue 668); nothing in the shell's look changes.
